name: Local ledger
description: Transfers conserve balance, reject unauthorized/invalid requests and cannot charge a repeated ID twice.
specification: if actor = 0 ∧ s.sequence < id ∧ 0 < amount ∧ amount ≤ s.debit ∧ s.credit + amount ≤ 18446744073709551615 then { debit := s.debit - amount, credit := s.credit + amount, sequence := id } else s

properties.name: rejection
properties.description: An unpermitted request leaves state unchanged.
properties.statement: ¬(actor = 0 ∧ s.sequence < id ∧ 0 < amount ∧ amount ≤ s.debit ∧ s.credit + amount ≤ 18446744073709551615) → out = s

properties.name: valid_transfer
properties.description: A permitted request moves exactly the amount and records its ID.
properties.statement: (actor = 0 ∧ s.sequence < id ∧ 0 < amount ∧ amount ≤ s.debit ∧ s.credit + amount ≤ 18446744073709551615) → out = { debit := s.debit - amount, credit := s.credit + amount, sequence := id }

properties.name: old_request
properties.description: An old request ID cannot transfer.

properties.name: repeated_request
properties.description: Repeating a successful request has no further effect.
properties.statement: transition out actor id amount = out

properties.name: bounded_result
properties.description: All output fields fit in u64.

assumptions: The caller authenticates the actor and uses this transition for all ledger changes.
